extracted.name: Rosemary Potatoes with Roasted Heads of Garlic
extracted.description: Rosemary potatoes with roasted heads of garlic is a wonderful recipe, especially when you add roasted garlic, which makes it a crowd-pleasing favorite.
ingredient_lines: 4 pounds new red potatoes, cut into 1-inch pieces
2 large heads garlic, top third sliced off and discarded
salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).

Arrange potatoes in a large roasting pan; nestle garlic, cut-sides up, among potatoes. Dot potatoes and garlic with butter; sprinkle with rosemary. Drizzle wine and olive oil over top; season with salt and black pepper.
Bake in the preheated oven until potatoes are golden and crisp and garlic is soft when squeezed, about 45 minutes.
